mods.name: SaveMyItems
mods.description: Backup and manage Invetory items. Giving you flexibility when items are, lost, bugged or else!

releases.notes:
### **Initial SaveMyItems release!**

![Preview](https://i.postimg.cc/k4bbSjch/Screenshot-2025-12-29-222352.png)

### **This release has following features:**

- Restore the whole Inventory
- Restore a single Item
- Choose the receiving target
- Audit logs
- Configurable Backup interval (ingame)
- Configurable Retention interval (ingame)

### **Note:**
This is a beta, things might not work as expected.
Please help the development by submitting bug reports.
